display.purpose: Names the selected serving strategy at the top of the work area.

headline.purpose: Names compact trace and control-desk panels.

body.purpose: Explains tradeoffs and carries generated model content.

label.purpose: Marks endpoints, telemetry, statuses, timestamps, and key commands.

shadows.name: signal-ring
shadows.purpose: Defines an inactive route dot without lifting its containing surface.

shadows.name: health-halo
shadows.purpose: Gives the tiny healthy-runtime signal enough presence to be noticed.

motion.name: route-travel
motion.purpose: Moves the live request signal from Client toward Response while a request is in flight.

motion.name: active-signal
motion.purpose: Breathes the tiny active-stage signal without moving layout.

motion.name: stream-cursor
motion.purpose: Marks an actively growing streamed response.

components.name: Dispatch Button
components.description: Primary full-width action for dispatching the current serving experiment.
components.css: .ds-dispatch { display:grid; grid-template-columns:8px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:11px; width:100%; min-height:50px; padding:10px 14px; color:#071014; background:var(--route, #22d3ee); border:0; border-radius:7px; font:700 13px Onest, sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-dispatch-signal { width:7px; height:7px; background:#071014; border-radius:50%; } .ds-dispatch kbd { color:rgba(7,16,20,.62); font:10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-dispatch:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-dispatch:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-dispatch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Quiet utility action used for examples and event-log clearing.
components.css: .ds-text-action { min-height:44px; padding:6px 4px; color:var(--route, #22d3ee); background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:7px; font:500 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; cursor:pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover { color:#edf3f8; } .ds-text-action:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Prompt Field
components.description: Monospaced prompt editor inside the experiment panel.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Prompt<textarea class="ds-field" rows="4">Объясни, зачем нужен batching на GPU.</textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; color:#98a6b7; font:11px Onest, sans-serif; } .ds-field { display:block; width:100%; min-height:120px; margin-top:8px; padding:13px 14px; color:#edf3f8; background:#080c11; border:1px solid #374554; border-radius:7px; outline:0; resize:vertical; font:12px/1.65 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:#485769; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color:var(--route, #22d3ee); background:#0a0f15; outline:2px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Active Strategy Item
components.description: Selected serving route in the strategy rail.
components.css: .ds-mode-item { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:10px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:11px; width:100%; min-height:58px; padding:8px 10px; color:#edf3f8; background:rgba(34,211,238,.11); border:0; border-radius:8px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-mode-item::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:10px auto 10px -8px; width:2px; background:var(--route, #22d3ee); } .ds-mode-dot { width:8px; height:8px; background:var(--route, #22d3ee); border:2px solid #080c11; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--route, #22d3ee); } .ds-mode-item strong { display:block; font:600 13px Onest, sans-serif; } .ds-mode-item small { display:block; margin-top:2px; color:#7f8da0; font:10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-mode-item kbd { color:#7f8da0; font:10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-mode-item:hover { background:#141c25; } .ds-mode-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Control Panel
components.description: Flat bordered surface shared by experiment, telemetry, inspector, and event sections.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:20px; color:#edf3f8; background:#0b1016; border:1px solid #25303b; border-radius:12px; font:14px/1.5 Onest, sans-serif; } .ds-panel > span { color:#7f8da0; font:9px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:5px 0 14px; font-size:14px; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; color:#98a6b7; font-size:11px; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color:#374554; } .ds-panel:focus-within { border-color:var(--route, #22d3ee); }

components.name: Active Route Station
components.description: Signature metro node for the stage currently handling a request.
components.css: .ds-route-stage { display:grid; grid-template-columns:32px 1fr; align-items:center; gap:11px; min-height:72px; padding:12px 6px; color:#edf3f8; background:#0b1016; font-family:Onest, sans-serif; } .ds-station { display:grid; place-items:center; width:32px; height:32px; color:#070a0d; background:var(--route, #22d3ee); border:1px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); border-radius:50%; font:600 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-route-stage strong { display:block; font-size:12px; } .ds-route-stage small { display:block; margin-top:3px; color:#7f8da0; font:9px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-route-stage:hover .ds-station { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-route-stage:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Telemetry Row
components.description: Border-separated instrument readout for timing and batch measurements.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); color:#edf3f8; background:#0b1016; border-top:1px solid #25303b; border-bottom:1px solid #25303b; } .ds-metrics div { min-width:0; padding:12px 10px; border-right:1px solid #25303b; } .ds-metrics div:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-metrics span, .ds-metrics strong { display:block; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-metrics span { color:#7f8da0; font-size:10px; } .ds-metrics strong { margin-top:6px; font-size:12px; } .ds-metrics div:hover strong { color:var(--route, #22d3ee); } .ds-metrics:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--route, #22d3ee); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
LLM Serving Lab treats inference as a visible transit network rather than a generic chat dashboard. Near-black control surfaces, fine route lines, compact status labels, and instrument-like readouts make the application feel like a calm operations room where the mechanism is always more important than decoration.

The system is dense but ordered. A strategy selects one colored route through Client, Queue, Model, and Response; the rest of the interface stays neutral so that live state, measured output, and route differences remain legible. Motion is reserved for actual request progress and streaming state, and the same interface remains useful when reduced motion is requested.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal layers separated by fine structural lines.
A single mode-specific route color carries state through navigation, controls, and trace stations.
Sans-serif explanation paired with monospaced endpoints, telemetry, labels, and event time.
Compact control-desk density with a dominant, observable request route.
Responsive transformation from horizontal control room to vertical mobile route.

rules.name: The One Active Route Rule
rules.body: Exactly one strategy color may carry the active interaction state at a time; inactive structure stays neutral.

rules.name: The Signal Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors communicate route identity, health, progress, focus, or failure—not ornament.

rules.name: The Two-Language Rule
rules.body: Use Onest for concepts and model content; use JetBrains Mono only for machine-readable facts and control metadata.

rules.name: The Route-First Rule
rules.body: The observable Client-to-Response path remains above controls and telemetry at every viewport; never bury it below the generated answer.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with surface tone and network lines; do not lift ordinary panels with generic shadows.

rules.name: The Station Geometry Rule
rules.body: Circles belong to signals and route nodes; content containers remain low-radius rectangles.

dos: Do keep the current mode's route color consistent across navigation, dispatch, focus, trace, and result metadata.
Do expose measured request state and timings in compact monospaced readouts.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, readable contrast, reduced-motion behavior, and the vertical mobile route.
Do use fine lines and tonal differences to organize dense educational information.
donts: Don't turn the application into a generic message-bubble chat or a collection of interchangeable analytics cards.
Don't add decorative charts, gradients, broad glows, or invented performance claims.
Don't use multiple route colors as simultaneous decoration; a color must correspond to an actual mode or semantic state.
Don't replace operational density with oversized marketing spacing or hide the serving mechanism behind the generated text.
